[1.0.0] — 2026-04-03
Initial Release

Phase 1 — Market Niche Explorer: Hierarchical breakdown of Health, Wealth, and Relationships markets down to sub-niche level. Supports both random exploration and focused single-niche drilling.
Phase 2 — Pain Point Research Queries: Platform-specific search query templates for Reddit, X, Threads, LinkedIn, and Google. Reddit query uses advanced intext: operators targeting emotional, first-person language.
Phase 3 — Market Gap & Solution Generator: 5-framework solution generation system (Market Segmentation, Product Differentiation, Business Model Innovation, Distribution & Marketing, New Paradigm) with structured output per concept and Top 3 Opportunity Assessment.
Phase 4 — Landing Page Generator: Full BAB (Before-After-Bridge) copywriting framework applied to a single-file HTML landing page artifact. Includes mobile-responsive design requirements and reference to copywriting-guide.md.
references/copywriting-guide.md: Standalone BAB copywriting guide with tone-by-niche table, headline rules, pain point writing rules, CTA copy guidance, and design-copy alignment notes.
